name: AI Lead Chatbot
description: AI-powered lead-generation chat widget backed by OpenAI that converses with visitors and stores captured leads as chatbot_lead entities.
project_description: AI Lead Chatbot is an AI-powered chat widget that engages site visitors in a natural conversation and captures leads without a traditional contact form. A floating chat button (rendered via a block or auto-attached to non-admin pages) opens a widget that talks to visitors through OpenAI's chat completions API; the bot's job is to extract three pieces of information from the conversation — the service the visitor wants, their name, and a phone or email contact — and, once all three are gathered, persist them as a chatbot_lead content entity that staff review under Content → Chatbot Leads. Conversation state is held per session in Drupal's private tempstore. The chatbot's business name, tone, FAQ knowledge, OpenAI model, temperature, max-tokens, and widget auto-display are configured at Configuration → Services → AI Lead Chatbot; the OpenAI API key is read from settings.php (the ai_lead_chatbot_openai_api_key setting), not from stored config. Because leads are Drupal entities, they integrate with Views for custom reports and exports.
